name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 9 Advanced Google Maps Optimization
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Fine-tuning to reach the local 3-pack.

# Key points
- Only 3 businesses show by default, so you must beat competitors, not just match them.
- Re-check NAP conflicts; old numbers or addresses can hold a listing back.
- Google Posts every week or two; keep hours, photos and attributes current.
- Steady stream of fresh reviews and owner responses (2 to 3 per month to start; consistency beats bursts).
- Set service areas correctly and mention neighborhoods on the site and in the GBP description.
- Track rankings (incognito with location set, or a rank tracker) every couple of weeks; investigate competitors that outrank you.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Daily GBP photo posts for Summit and Pipeliners are part of Kim's start-of-day routine (posted manually, not by Claude).
- Map grid tracking for all three main clients comes from [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) and feeds the [Client Report Dashboard](lib:brain-client-report-dashboard).
